div.blockquote: “We wanted a company where clients always know who to call. If that means staying smaller in some places, that's fine with us.”

div.p: Laura and Mark Holloway had both spent years at large brokerages. In 2009 they opened something smaller, where each client keeps one agent from the first viewing to closing.
Miami came in 2014 because clients were buying second homes there and asked us to help. New York, Austin, Aspen and San Francisco followed the same way.
